WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99
),
per_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_rating_avg
)
SELECT
  pra.rating,
  pra.avg_ratio,
  pra.avg_ratio - om.overall_avg AS difference
FROM per_rating_avg pra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE pra.avg_ratio > om.overall_avg
ORDER BY pra.rating;
